note: No measurement: the receiver is taken as exact until `bash ~/Slot17/setup.sh car`, or `python3 p0/calibrate.py`, measures it from TETRA downlink carriers and writes calibration.local.json, which then counts. Signed updates never replace this file or that one. Until 26 November 2026 this file held the project's own Airspy Mini's +4.09 ppm, which suits no other receiver (found in review).
